prompt: Numbered senses of a word with usage examples.
shortDesc: Numbered senses of a word in serif type, each with an optional italic usage example. Just give it the word: it looks up the definitions itself (optionally only one part of speech).

props.name: word
props.description: The word to define, e.g. serendipity.

props.name: part-of-speech
props.description: Only show senses for this part of speech, e.g. noun.

styling.notes: Gilt sense numbers; 18px Newsreader text; sepia italic examples; small italic part-of-speech label per group.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'look up a word', word, outputFormat: { word, phonetic, origin, meanings: [{ partOfSpeech, definitions: [{ text, example }], synonyms: [], antonyms: [] }] } }
